items.item:
2. Two services with one token stop the start, and so does each other pair
   of equal secrets: a token and the owner credential, a token and the
   backup key, the owner credential and the backup key.
   Shows A17-2. [witness: verification:registry_a17_equal_secrets_stop_start]
statements:
```text
serving => checks_passed(config)   -- A17-1
for secrets s1 != s2 in config: value(s1) != value(s2) and len >= SECRET_MIN_BYTES   -- A17-2
```

verdicts.why: The check covers all fifteen pairs of the six secrets and requires every equal pair to fail startup, with the owner listener closed. It does not assert the minimum secret length, and it does not directly verify that the service listener is also closed.
